source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
The sole undefeated Singles player usually wins. When too few rounds leave no single unbeaten player, or players want places for everyone else, rank equal records by:

1. win, loss and draw record
2. strength of schedule: the win records of each player's opponents
3. total Victory points (VP)

In Warhammer 40,000, VP rarely show how close a game was: a tougher opponent can hold scores down, and an army matchup can force a risky plan that widens the margin. So use VP neither for pairing nor for ranking until the other criteria are exhausted or a large event needs more tie-breaks. Opponents' records better show which of 2 equal records was harder earned.

whenRankingsNeeded: too few rounds to identify a sole undefeated player
rankingOrder: record of wins, losses and draws
strength of schedule from opponents’ results

examples: a tougher opponent can suppress scores

detail.scheduleGuidance: opponent results distinguish how difficult identical records were
